title: Retained Clothing and Textile Construction

construction_contract.body_ownership: Embodied geometry and materials remain independent of textiles.
construction_contract.simulation_cage: A coarse quad-oriented source cage retains ordered seam and closure constraints.
construction_contract.render_surface: A separately owned adaptive visible surface carries smooth deformation, UVs, normals, and material response.
construction_contract.seams: Closure seams, overlaps, fasteners, and open boundaries remain semantically distinct.
construction_contract.construction_reveal: A shader coverage mask reveals a continuous visible surface; topology is never spawned.

acceptance: The canonical GLB reopens with embedded textures and no external URIs.
Body, simulation cage, and visible garment ownership are disjoint.
The tunic cage contains ordered vertex-pair sewing constraints.
Visible garment surfaces use variable adaptive row density rather than one uniform Cartesian lattice.
Body materials contain no textile base or normal maps.
Visible garments contain smooth weight fields with more than ten distinct normalized weight vectors.
The package exposes dressed, body-only, detached-render, and simulation-cage verification states.
The construction viewer uses a UV coverage reveal and never exposes partial topology.

not_claimed: CLO or Marvelous Designer native project export
